bounded_resolution: Shared Semantic Foundations is a portfolio/index of deliberately small reusable primitives, not a universal semantic owner. Each primitive retains a named native authority class and bounded meaning. Domain policy is imported, not promoted to universal semantics. Business calendar, money, probability and verification-receipt misplacements are explicitly re-homed by the fixed-point campaign.
invalidation_condition: Reopen whenever a proposed shared member cannot demonstrate stable semantics across at least two unrelated domains without importing hidden domain policy.

bounded_resolution: Platform Commercial & Support is a portfolio of commercial/customer/billing/payment/support lifecycles, not a mega-aggregate and not an estate identity owner. Tenant and platform-account identity are re-homed to Platform Estate & Tenancy Administration; commercial party roles import upstream party/legal-entity identity. Product/catalog, usage/rating/bill, payment/refund and ticket/problem/incident keep separate identities and authorities. Supplier-exit and service-maintenance semantics are explicitly imported from their sovereign supplier/contract and service-maintenance owners and are not owned by this family.
noncollapse_laws: tenant != platform account != commercial customer != billing account
trouble ticket != service problem != incident cause
invalidation_condition: Reopen if supplier-exit/maintenance responsibilities are claimed as owned rather than imported, or if product boundary migration changes their sovereign owner.

bounded_resolution: Route provenance propositions and bundles to W3C PROV, observed operational lineage to OpenLineage, authenticated artifact claims to in-toto attestation layers, and keep verification, appraisal and acceptance as distinct assurance contracts. The family is a composition boundary across epistemic layers, not a single lineage authority.
noncollapse_laws: absence of an observed lineage edge under open coverage != proof of non-dependency
invalidation_condition: Reopen when a new evidence/attestation class cannot be represented without collapsing claim, evidence, verification, appraisal or acceptance.

bounded_resolution: The governance/metadata/ontology package is a composition/index boundary. Concept schemes and directional mappings import SKOS; formal ontology semantics import OWL/profile authority; metadata registry concepts and representations import ISO/IEC 11179; catalog/resource/dataset/distribution/service semantics import DCAT; code systems/value sets, master/reference records, policy/classification and certification retain separate bounded owners.
noncollapse_laws: SKOS exactMatch != OWL sameAs != entity merge
invalidation_condition: Reopen on any proposed crosswalk that erases lifecycle, directionality, issuer, edition or evidence distinctions.

bounded_resolution: Consumption/BI/Visualization is an operated presentation/composition family. Declarative visual grammar, accessibility semantics, semantic query/metric meaning, disclosure policy, publication lifecycle and interaction/runtime state remain distinct. Presentation may import data transformations only when their semantic loss and aggregation rules are explicit.
noncollapse_laws: presentation aggregation != source semantic aggregation authority
interaction selection/filter state != business decision or authorization
invalidation_condition: Reopen if a presentation feature attempts to own metric/query semantics, domain state, disclosure authority or business effects.
